sources.note: Main website. Overview of company (founded 1999, Brea CA), core products: EMR, practice management, billing, RPM, CCM, RTM, telehealth, AI features. Lists 12 service categories.
ONC mandatory disclosures page. Certified through SLI Compliance. Links to RWT plans 2022-2025 and EHI export documentation. Minimal product detail beyond compliance.

EMR feature page. Cloud-based EMR with point-and-click templates, dictation, handwriting recognition, image annotation, customizable templates, medication refills, lab results, WEBeMobile iPad edition.

Practice management features: multi-provider/multi-location scheduling, patient demographics, pre-visit checklist, electronic claims, double scrubbing via Change Healthcare, reporting on all structured data.
Patient portal: 24/7 access to billing info, lab results, medication history, educational materials/videos, secure messaging, appointment requests, refill requests.
Services overview listing 12 modules: billing, e-faxing, EMR/WEBeMobile, practice management, patient portal, telehealth, tele-reminders, patient kiosk, RPM, CCM, RTM, WEBeBiller.
FAQ page. Web-based architecture, 256-bit SSL, no hidden fees, unlimited claims/charts/users, one-day onboarding, phone support M-F 8:30-4:30 PST.
About page. Founded 1999, Brea CA. Mission to provide complete software for front-office to point-of-care. Unified Desktop product. Several hundred users nationwide. Direct sales + VARs.

Older products page listing specialty variants: WEBeVision (eye care), WebeCardio (cardiology), WebePeds (pediatrics), WebePodi (podiatry), WEBeRx (e-prescribing), WEBeXpress (dispatch/billing), WEBeBiller, WEBeMobile.
Company background page. Same info as about page: founded 1999, several hundred users, multi-channel distribution.

Third-party review site. 4/5 stars, 5 reviews. Confirms features: scheduling, e-prescriptions, labs, billing, portal. Partners: Microsoft, Oracle, HP, LabCorp, Quest. Surescripts White Coat award. ~$133/mo pricing.

Review/listing site. Cloud-based EMR+PM for all practice sizes. Features: RCM, e-prescriptions, telehealth, patient portal, billing, scheduling. Specialties: cardiology, ophthalmology, podiatry, pediatrics.

Software Advice listing. Confirms web-based workflow solution with scheduling, reminders, insurance verification, EMR, e-prescriptions, eLabs, transcription, referrals, billing. Mixed reviews praising customizability and support.
Capterra listing (403 when fetched). Search snippet mentions Apache Foot and Ankle Specialists as customer. Reviews cite good customization but limited after-hours support.
RocketReach company profile. Reports ~11 employees and ~$8.5M revenue. Confirms Brea CA headquarters.
Press release about WEBeRx electronic prescribing system, confirming e-prescribing as a core capability.
